scope: 108 immutable indexed PNG captures; personally viewed every image using tools.view_image. No builds, source edits or image edits. Agent visual review only; no native-human, physical-device or interactive accessibility certification.

findings.area: Phone language/player settings; blank lower screen
findings.observation: No Done/footer/close visible at 390x844. Other phone settings frames show a Done footer. Bulgarian field labels themselves are clear.
findings.impact: If the screenshot reflects final settled state and there is no alternate exit mechanism, user cannot leave settings via a visible control.
findings.disposition: Hold control-access approval for this frame pending investigation; static frame alone cannot establish interactive availability.

Запазване на повторението wraps with final о alone; readable and entirely inside button.

conclusion: Bulgarian Cyrillic and localized prose are legible throughout the personally viewed captures. No confirmed critical issue or confirmed localization major issue observed. 107 frames approved for static visual localization; phone-settings-player exit access remains held. Minor wrapping/ellipsis notes do not block readability.
